name: Traffic restriction type code qualifier
description: Code qualifying a type of traffic restriction.

values.name: Required stopover or connection must occur at the board
values.description: Required stopover or connection must occur at the board point Required stopover or connection from another station to a means of transport can only be made at the board point.

values.name: Required stopover or connection must occur at the off point
values.description: Required stopover or connection must occur at the off point Required stopover or connection from another station to a means of transport can only be made at the off point.
